properties.label: Command button as product object
properties.text: Centre one oversized command button beneath a short headline on a quiet warm instrument ground.

properties.label: Readable engraved label
properties.text: Give the monochrome label an engraved appearance while retaining clear legibility.

properties.label: Ivory with signal indicator
properties.text: Use warm ivory #f2f1ee, graphite and a tiny orange or green indicator.

properties.label: Machined layered command
properties.text: Construct a machined outer bezel, recessed track, raised cap, separate indicator window and small fasteners, with visible thickness, inset shadow, edge bevels and directional highlights.

properties.label: Short cap depression
properties.text: Depress the cap slightly on press while preserving the button's dimensions through every state.

properties.label: Honest copy indicator
properties.text: On successful copy, update the indicator and an accessible status; never display success after a failed copy.

properties.label: Three-plane command acceptance
properties.text: Verify bezel, slot and cap as three distinct planes, and keep the entire command operable and legible at 390px without shrinking it into a toy.
